_what: Every verbatim quotation this night's work takes from a primary text, with the source it comes from and what it is used to decide. Hand-written; no script owns this file. verify.py checks each one against the extracted source by letter sequence -- lowercased, with all spaces and hyphens removed -- because sources/extract.py decides word gaps with a kerning heuristic and gets some of them wrong. The spacing inside each quotation below is therefore mine; the letters are the source's.
_why_short: R2004 carries no licence permitting redistribution, so it is quoted at citation length and its text is not committed. R2016 is CC BY 4.0 and its extracted text is committed beside this file.

quotes.decides: the pair, and that they are two positions in one unit
quotes.text: Within them, scientific objects – “epistemic things” – and technical objects – the technical conditions of their production – are inextricably linked with each other in a given experimental unit.

quotes.decides: P3, and the axis: the epistemic pole is the undetermined one
quotes.text: The first entity, the scientific object, is that badly defined something to be addressed as the target of the whole experimental endeavor. Paradoxically speaking, it embodies in an experimentally manipulable manner what one does not yet exactly know. The scientific object is therefore mandatorily underdetermined; it is blurred by definition. The technical objects, in contrast, are characteristically determined.

quotes.decides: the same axis, stated again nineteen years later
quotes.text: Epistemic objects are thus characteristically underdetermined. Technical objects, in contrast, are characteristically determined.

quotes.decides: P1 and P6 -- the passage runs in both directions
quotes.text: Within a particular research process, epistemic things can eventually be turned into technical things and become incorporated into the technical conditions of the system. And parts of the technical system can acquire epistemic status and thus turn into research objects.

quotes.decides: P2 -- technicity is conferred by position, not built in
quotes.text: Instruments, however, should not be hypostasized as such. They receive their meaning less from the technical identity conditions built into them, than from the experimental contexts in which they become inserted as technical objects.

quotes.decides: P2 -- the crossing is relative to a setup
quotes.text: we observe the trans-formation of an epistemic object that has become stabilized – amino acid activation – into an experimental subroutine, that is, into a technical object in the context of the given experimental setup

quotes.decides: P2 -- explicitly not a property of the object
quotes.text: Becoming obsolete has, as a rule at least, less to do with the intrinsic quali-ties of the epistemic object, but more with a displacement of promise from one epistemic object to another.

quotes.decides: the decisive one: the object stays, the stake moves
quotes.text: the biochemical object in the strict sense of the word remains, but its meaning and with that, its functional stake is being transformed

quotes.decides: the un-normed difference, named in the source
quotes.text: A difference in the velocity of protein synthesis showed up indeed in the first experiments on the way to an in vitro system, but this difference remained mute experimentally: It did not lend itself further specification.

quotes.decides: P5 -- difference is generated by the system
quotes.text: In order to remain productive, experimental systems must be organized in such a way that the generation of differences becomes the reproductive driving force of the whole machinery.

quotes.decides: an instrument deciding which differences are visible
quotes.text: the radioactive marker carried with it the potential of distinction that left everything else in the background

quotes.decides: what an epistemic thing's reality consists in
quotes.text: The reality of an epistemic thing explored within an experimental system resides in its resistance, its resilience, its capacity, as a joker and obstacle of practice, to turn around our previsions as well as our imprevisions

quotes.decides: P6 -- the reverse passage, in a case
quotes.text: that resists being purified away turns into an epistemic object that has unique biochemical characteristics

quotes.decides: what an epistemic object is, in one line
quotes.text: Epistemic objects are the targets of research, those things about which we would like to know more. That is why they are particularly elusive.

quotes.decides: the technical pole's job is to hold the epistemic pole open
quotes.text: They are necessary in order to keep the vagueness of the scientific objects in a hypocritical condition.

quotes.decides: P1 -- stated as a flat rule, not only as a case
quotes.text: Epistemic things can be turned into technical ob-jects.
